name: Starlink
description: Over 11,000 active satellites (as of October 2026) at 550 km in 53° / 70° / 97.6° shells — the largest LEO constellation ever flown. SpaceX broadband internet, operational since 2019. Autonomous collision avoidance + laser inter-satellite links. Visible as a train of bright dots crossing the sky in the days after each launch.
scale_fact: Starlink performs >50,000 autonomous avoidance manoeuvres per year across the constellation — more than every other operator combined.
